integrity: Every claim in this package concerns only the quantitative positivity margin of the specified real symmetric octic. No computations replace the all-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Proves \(\Theta(n^{-4})\) with nonoptimal constants; no exact extrema, optimal asymptotic coefficient, or independent validation. The source supplies the form and known positivity; earlier SOS result is not claimed here.
title: Sharp fourth-power decay of the positivity margin for a symmetric octic
